page.overview:
Who is Dolg?

Dolg is shown to be a giant man with an appearance heavily inspired by [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glam_rock glam rock]. He wears a blue set of armor consisting of a chest plate and what appear to be arm guards, both of which are adorned with spikes. A tube of sorts can be seen connecting the back of his head to his chest plate. He also has matching blue face paint.
